description:
Implements option (b) from op-t33q / GitHub issue #24: the Zhu-Hawari generalized
coherent-elastic scattering formulation for the LEAPR port (crates/njoy-outram-park-fork/src/leapr/coher.rs
or a new sibling module), so SiC (and any non-built-in crystalline scatterer) gets
a real coherent-elastic MF=7/MT=2 channel instead of iel=0 (no lattice) silence.

Prerequisite literature (workspace HARD RULE: must be catalogued before use):
  - Zhu, Y. (2014). Thermal Neutron Scattering Cross Sections for Silicon Carbide.
    MS thesis, NC State University. NOW CATALOGUED in kovan-literature as
    open/theses/zhu2014thermal.{json,pdf} (2026-08-19).
  - Zhu, Y. and Hawari, A. (2015). Implementation of a Generalized Coherent Elastic
    Scattering Formulation for Thermal Neutron Scattering Analysis. ICNC 2015
    (OSTI 23100909). NOT yet catalogued -- not located as a freely downloadable PDF
    this session. The 2014 thesis's chapter on the coherent-elastic routine is the
    primary source available; note this gap rather than skip the ICNC paper silently.

Oracle to validate against: reference-data/endf/tsl-CinSiC.endf (MAT 44) and
tsl-SiinSiC.endf (MAT 43), already committed (op-84v6). CRITICAL: both tapes carry
BYTE-IDENTICAL MF=7/MT=2 (coherent elastic is a lattice property of 3C-SiC as a
whole, not per-sublattice) -- see reference-data/endf/README.md. A correct
implementation must not double-count this when both materials are wired into one
SiC region.

Test targets: crates/outram-mc-libs/tests/triso_shell_thermal_scattering.rs's
sic_carbon_elastic_channel_is_missing_from_the_embedded_deck and
sic_silicon_elastic_channel_is_missing_from_the_embedded_deck currently assert
elastic == 0.0 ON PURPOSE (a gap-detector). Once real coherent-elastic data is
produced from tsl-CinSiC.leapr / tsl-SiinSiC.leapr via leapr::generate::generate_tape,
these two tests will fail -- that failure is the intended signal to update them
(and crates/outram-mc-libs/src/geometry/triso_particle.rs's module doc) rather
than a regression to chase.

Conventions to follow: njoy-outram-park-fork's Sonnet-ports/Opus-verifies split
(this bead's assignment is a variation -- Opus implements AND tests, per explicit
maintainer instruction) -- port faithfully where the thesis specifies an algorithm,
mark genuinely new synthesis clearly; 1000-line (1500 max) file-size cap, split into
a module_name/ directory per src/samm/coulomb/ if needed; GPL-3.0 provenance
headers citing the thesis; V&V doc comments with methodology + measured results
per the root CLAUDE.md V&V rule; enum dispatch not trait objects, no Box<T>, no
lifetimes, uom at physics boundaries.

Mirrors GitHub issue #24 (theodoreOnzGit/outram-park-backend) and op-t33q.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content:
CHECKPOINT 2026-08-19/20, pushed as commit 8933cdbf on develop. The Opus
agent implementing this was stopped mid-run (maintainer instruction) at a
stable, compiling, passing checkpoint rather than left running further.

Implemented: coher::coher_general_with_constants, a general reciprocal-
lattice Bragg-edge sum for an arbitrary CrystalStructure, replacing the
iel=0 silence for SiC. Measured 2.853825 b vs oracle 2.94078 b (-2.96%) for
both C-in-SiC and Si-in-SiC, correctly identical between the two materials.
3 new passing tests in leapr_sic_coherent_elastic_oracle.rs. The two
outram-mc-libs gap tests that asserted elastic==0.0 are now #[ignore]d
(with the measured numbers in their doc comments) rather than rewritten to
a final assertion -- that, plus root-causing the ~3% gap, plus a full
edge-by-edge oracle comparison, plus the still-missing ICNC 2015 companion
paper, are tracked in the new follow-up bead op-4daf (dependency added).

Leaving this bead in_progress rather than closing it -- op-4daf is real
remaining work, not polish.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content:
CLOSING 2026-08-21. The capability this bead was opened for exists and is in
develop (commits 8933cdbf, 1a904fc5).

DELIVERED
  - Generalized coherent-elastic formulation in src/leapr/coher/ (builtin.rs =
    the 6 hand-coded NJOY lattices, crystals.rs = crystal structures incl.
    3C-SiC, general.rs = the general reciprocal-lattice Bragg sum), wired into
    leapr::generate. tsl-CinSiC / tsl-SiinSiC now emit a real MF=7/MT=2
    section instead of nothing (card 4 iel=0 previously meant silence).
  - Elastic 2.85 b against the tape's 2.94 b, and identical between the two
    materials, which is the physically required behaviour (coherent elastic is
    a property of the 3C-SiC compound, not a sublattice) and the documented
    double-counting trap; pinned by a test.
  - Zhu (2014) MS thesis catalogued in kovan-literature as the prerequisite
    (open/theses/zhu2014thermal.{json,pdf}).

ALSO ESTABLISHED SINCE, and worth recording here because it bounds where the
residual can be: the INELASTIC half of the same material is exact.
Regenerating Si-in-SiC MT=4 reproduces the published ENDF/B-VIII.0 tape at all
8 declared temperatures -- 306,033 points, worst 0.0000%, T_eff exact
(test leapr_temperature_block_selection.rs). So deck parsing, alpha/beta grids,
phonon expansion, Debye-Waller/T_eff and the endout writer are all faithful
for this material; the ~3% is confined to the elastic path.

NOT DONE, all carried by op-4daf (which depends on this bead):
  - root-cause the ~3% elastic gap (2.85169 vs 2.94078 b at 300 K)
  - edge-by-edge comparison against the tape's 1044 MT=2 records
  - rewrite the two #[ignore]d gap tests in outram-mc-libs to real assertions
  - the general-vs-builtin high-energy divergence in the #[ignore]d diagnostic
  - Zhu & Hawari ICNC 2015 still not located/catalogued

Closing as done rather than leaving open indefinitely: the deliverable landed,
and every remaining item has a home in op-4daf.
